links.outcome: Translation accuracy of AI tools for Chinese-to-Japanese outpatient consultations, by tool and specialty
links.effect: Google Translate and UD Talk median accuracy 2.0 (IQR 1.0-3.0) versus ChatGPT 5.0 (IQR 4.0-5.0), P<.001; ChatGPT consistent across cardiology and pulmonology.
links.quote: ChatGPT had significantly higher translation accuracy and satisfaction scores than Google Translate and UD Talk, with median scores of 5.0 (IQR 4.0-5.0) for both outcomes compared with 2.0 (IQR 1.0-3.0) for Google Translate and UD Talk (P<.001), and maintained a consistently high performance in both specialties.

unlisted_practices: Comparing candidate AI translation tools head-to-head on real recorded consultations, rated by professional medical interpreters and lay participants
Using AI translation as a complementary aid alongside professional interpreter services

screen.reason: The study evaluates the translation accuracy and satisfaction of ChatGPT, Google Translate, and UD Talk on transcripts of outpatient clinical encounters, comparing tool performance without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
